<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
bitwise_left_shift(x, y) -> 'core.SymbolicTensor'
```

Part of [`evoxc.ops`](/api/evoxc/ops/)

Elementwise bitwise left shift (`x << y`). Both operands must have
integer dtype (`core.DTypeError` otherwise — bool is NOT accepted;
numpy's bool shift is a promotion artifact and StableHLO has no i1
shift). Dtype/shape rules identical to `add` (operands promote
per `np.result_type`; the shift amount broadcasts against `x`).

[View Python source](https://github.com/EMI-Group/evoxc/blob/main/evoxc/ops/elementwise.py#L496)
